versions.changelog:
- Significant cleanup of repository: removed obsolete CHANGELOG.md, README.md, scenario, and script files.
- Migrated shared runtime rules to local references; now requires reading `references/gate-runtime-rules.md` and `references/info-news-runtime-rules.md`.
- Updated installation and MCP server check instructions for clarity and local context.
- Streamlined documentation to focus on active sub-scenarios, valid MCP tools, and core routing logic.
- Enhanced progressive loading instructions and clarified the workflow for Bridges and Stablecoins.
- No changes to supported features or user-facing toolset.

- Updated maintenance and update-check procedures to simplify and clarify instructions for interactive and non-interactive sessions.
- Added explicit MCP dependencies and a table of all used MCP tools for easier integration and audit.
- Supplemented documentation with required authentication, environment variables, and permissions (now all explicitly marked as unused/read-only).
- Routing rules and scenario breakdowns are reformatted and clarified for faster reference and user intent mapping.
- Removed lengthy shell-script maintenance walkthrough and replaced it with a clear, concise maintenance flow section.
- No changes to the logic, methods, or tool coverage; this update is documentation/metadata only.

- Initial release of the gate-info-defianalysis skill for DeFi ecosystem analysis via Gate-Info MCP.
- Supports queries for TVL rankings, protocol metrics, yield/APY, stablecoins, bridges, exchange reserves, and liquidation heatmaps.
- Automatically routes coin-only fundamental questions to the separate gate-info-coinanalysis skill.
- Includes detailed instructions for version update checks and user confirmation before applying updates.
- Provides clear trigger phrases and scenario-based tool routing for accurate DeFi data responses.
